title.en: Context Engineering: Windows, Budgets, Memory, and Retrieval

hook: Prompt engineering is a subset. Context engineering is the whole game. A prompt is a string you type. Context is everything that goes into the model's window: system instructions, retrieved documents, tool definitions, conversation history, few-shot examples, and the prompt itself. The best AI engineers in 2026 are context engineers. They decide what goes in, what stays out, and in what order.
